items.en: Night of 28-29 Sep: Russia strikes Ukraine with a Zircon, two ballistic missiles and 152 drones; Air Force claims 109 downed, two unexploded ballistic warheads defused in Kyiv
items.nl: Nacht van 28 op 29 sep: Rusland valt Oekraïne aan met een Zircon, twee ballistische raketten en 152 drones; luchtmacht claimt 109 neergehaald, twee niet-ontplofte ballistische gevechtskoppen in Kyiv onschadelijk gemaakt
items.sEn: Russia attacked Ukraine overnight on 28-29 September 2026 with one Zircon/Oniks anti-ship missile, two Iskander-M or S-400 ballistic missiles (launched from Kursk Oblast) and 152 drones, according to Ukraine's Air Force. items.en: Russia strikes Kyiv with drones by day, then Zircon and Iskander-M missiles overnight; Zelensky claims 60% of ballistic missiles intercepted

items.sEn: Over roughly 24 hours on 23–24 September 2026, Russia struck Kyiv first with a daytime drone attack and then overnight with a combined missile and drone strike. items.en: Russia widens strike campaign on Ukrainian industry and logistics: steel mills halted, Interpipe plant hit in Dnipro, 2.1 million m² of warehouses destroyed
